body:
App 版本: v1.5.0
Rust 引擎版本: v1.9.0

更新内容:

- Merge pull request #13 from KARAOKE-MASTER-ZJU/fix/duplicatedNextSong
- Merge pull request #15 from StarFreedomX/feat/room-dlna-1080p

- docs: 新增 CLAUDE.md 软链接、Rust 依赖位置与 release/tag 规范
- docs: readme.md添加飞书文档
